verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is a single line saying Bionic can run frontier open models such as GLM 5.2, Kimi K3 and DeepSeek V4 Pro "for your most demanding tasks." That hints at a capability beyond local hardware, but it never says the models are hosted in the cloud or that no download is needed. llmster's support for "cloud instances" is self-hosting LM Studio on your own server, not a hosted tier. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a hosted or cloud inference tier, confirmation that models run without being downloaded, details on how offloading works when local hardware is insufficient, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
